TREC 2025 separates functional substitutes, complements, known incompatibility, unknown compatibility, and insufficient evidence. This supports distinct diagnostic signals: potential redundancy among alternatives, explicit compatibility conflicts, and unassessable relationships. Substitutability alone does not establish unwanted redundancy or a fulfilled need. [TREC guidelines](https://trec-product-search.github.io/recommendations.html). ECCR (KDD 2024) uses co-view/view-to-purchase as substitute proxies and co-purchase as complement proxies; these are behavioral assumptions, not verified compatibility. With interaction histories alone, report training co-occurrence counts and temporal support as weak evidence, without claiming dislike or causal complementarity. [ECCR](https://assets.amazon.science/6a/b5/41364589408ead2fc48043b0ea5c/eccr-explainable-and-coherent-complement-recommendation-based-on-large-language-models.pdf).

WDC-PAVE (2024) evaluates attribute extraction and normalization from titles/descriptions against manually verified annotations. Its extraction-versus-normalization distinction is useful even without its pretrained models. A conservative adaptation: local patterns for explicit model identifiers, connectors, dimensions, voltage and formats; retain source spans, normalize unambiguous units, and mark absent, ambiguous or conflicting values unknown. [WDC-PAVE paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.02130). Manually audit a small sample stratified across all four categories, including asserted matches, conflicts and unknowns; report extraction precision, evidence coverage, unknown rate and incompatibility precision with denominators. These are proposed checks, not measured results.

Evaluate abstention through error among asserted diagnoses versus coverage, separately by category and diagnostic type. A 2026 study finds entropy alone can produce unreliable abstention; recommendation scores likewise need empirical validation before serving as diagnostic confidence. [Selective-prediction study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21172). Keep these evidence audits separate from the fixed macro validation HR@10 used for model selection.
